blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A member of the Philippine National Police Aviation Security Group on Wednesday, Oct. 28, detailed her involvement in the alleged shipment of 521 kilograms of shabu worth P3.5 billion that was intercepted in Laos on Oct. 1. Police Executive Master Sergeant Aileen Jayne Manalo Mendoza, however, maintained that the aircraft her friend asked her to rent was supposed to carry vapes and cigarettes.
